title: Father, child among eight Palestinians killed in Israeli attacks on Gaza
summary: Al Jazeera reports, citing local health sources, that Israeli attacks killed at least eight Palestinians on 10 November. It describes three deaths in an attack on a home in Daraj, a father and his 13-year-old son killed in an attack on a tent in Zeitoun, and a man killed by gunfire in Khan Younis. The article's later update cites Wafa reporting two further deaths in an attack in Sabra. These are attributed reports of separate incidents, not an independently verified final daily toll. They are not added to cumulative ceasefire or storm casualties.

title: Humanitarian Situation Report: Heavy Rains in the Gaza Strip | 8 November 2026
summary: OCHA's report titled 8 November, published on 9 November, describes rain beginning on 6 November and damage over that weekend to displacement sites, shelters and services across Gaza. Humanitarian partners reported more than 26,000 household appeals by 8 November; OCHA identifies the figures as preliminary. OCHA says Israeli restrictions on supplies and equipment and funding shortages constrain the response. This is a weekend assessment, not a new measurement on 10 November.

title: Four killed in Gaza after sand embankment collapses onto tents, health ministry says
summary: Reports concern one sandbank collapse at a displacement camp south of Deir al-Balah on 2026-11-08. Accounts and casualty figures are attributed separately below; they are not added together. BBC News: BBC reports that a sand embankment collapsed onto tents at a displaced-family camp south of Deir al-Balah on Sunday night, 8 November. Civil Defence initially reported five deaths. BBC says the Health Ministry revised that account on Monday morning to four: three children and one woman. This is one collapse, not two events; the initial and revised counts must not be added together. The Guardian: The Guardian reports that a sand bank collapsed onto tents at a displaced-family camp south of Deir al-Balah on Sunday, 8 November. Its retained article reports five deaths. This is its account of that collapse, not a separate event or a final independently verified toll; retain this report alongside the separately attributed BBC account rather than adding the counts.

title: Board of Peace says Israel's aid response after Gaza floods 'insufficent'
summary: BBC reported on 10 November that the Board of Peace called for Israel to allow necessary humanitarian supplies into Gaza after flooding and described the response as insufficient. The Board also blamed Hamas's failure to disarm and transfer authority for compounding hardship. COGAT said tents and winter supplies had entered Gaza and maintained restrictions on equipment it said could have military uses. Hamas disputed the Board's account and blamed Israeli restrictions. These are the parties' stated positions, not an independently established allocation of responsibility.
